graphEvents.label: Coverage requires two direct answering findings per question

label: A question counts as covered only when at least two findings answer it directly: coverage is the share of question nodes with two or more ANSWERS edges, so one strong answer plus supporting findings still counts as uncovered.

The same relation error depressed the diversity average rather than the evidence base: sourceDiversity is the mean distinct quality classes per question over all question nodes, so a question with no answering finding contributes zero even when its primary artifacts are recorded and cited.

reason: The implementation filters to ANSWERS before counting.
